Name: Uriel And Your Little Angel

Description:

 This mod is only published on Nexus Mods! No redistribution permissions have been granted whatsoever! Some platforms, such as 3DM, have been re-uploading this mod without authorization. If you come across such cases, please help report them!

I want to reiterate: this mod was created out of love for a mod that I truly enjoy! It will never be used for any commercial or profit-making purposes. Whether or not you credit the original creator's name, reposting without asking for permission first is extremely disrespectful to the author! Even worse, some have gone so far as to bundle it into mod packs! I know downloading from Nexus Mods might require a few extra steps, but this is a platform that actually protects authors' rights — unlike certain other platforms that do absolutely no vetting and allow anyone to freely re-upload content just to drive traffic and attention to their sites! That's one of the reasons I only publish on Nexus Mods!

What bothers me the most is simply that you didn't even bother to ask! It's incredibly rude and so selfish!

七宗罪NPC乌列的孩子扩展mod

女孩男孩将会拥有属于自己的肖像，对话框

上百+对话支持多语言，中文，韩语，日语，英语，俄罗斯语，动态翻译！

黄色警告和红色错误补丁不用管

婴儿也可以对话，孩子会出去玩，你可以给它送礼，和它玩游戏，给它做东西吃，让它跟着你，它会和居民们相处融洽

日程完全随机，路程随机，你可以在各种地方碰到孩子

支持多婚，不确定是否兼容手机版！

务必阅读里面的说明，会告诉你关于这个mod的游玩须知。

该mod不开源，不允许盈利并且二次传播
————————————————————————————
Uriel's Children Expansion Mod for the Seven Deadly Sins NPC

The boy and girl will each have their own unique portraits and dialogue boxes!

Over 100+ lines of dialogue with multi-language support — Chinese, Korean, Japanese, English, and Russian — with dynamic translation!

Yellow warnings and red patch errors can be safely ignored.

Even babies can be interacted with through dialogue! The child will go out to play. You can give them gifts, play games with them, cook food for them, and have them follow you around. They'll get along well with the townsfolk!

Their daily schedule is completely random, and their walking routes are randomized — you can run into your child in all sorts of places!

Compatible with polygamy mods. Mobile compatibility is not confirmed.

Be sure to read the included instructions — they'll tell you everything you need to know about playing with this mod.

This mod is closed-source. Commercial use and redistribution are strictly prohibited.

Downloads.Description:
下载这个版本以后，清空sdschild文件夹，再进一次游戏，这个版本是能够区分不同存档孩子的，这次修复以后，特定存档孩子不会跑到其他存档里。
